verdict.rationale: Fly.io's own docs describe deploying apps to regions worldwide so users connect to the nearest server over Anycast. Users control each Machine's region placement, can list available regions with `fly platform regions`, and get VMs in 18 regions close to their users. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of region-targeted deployment, and detailed docs on the exact region-selection configuration in the deploy workflow.

support.subject: As a devops-lead, I can deploy my application to specific regions closer to my users

citations.quote: You can deploy apps in regions worldwide, so your users in Tokyo, São Paulo, or Amsterdam connect to the nearest server through our global Anycast network.
you have control over every Machine’s lifecycle, resources, and region placement.
We build Machines out of the images you give us and we run them where you tell us to.
Run `fly platform regions` to get a list of regions.
Run the APIs behind your product on VMs in 18 regions, close to your users.
